goals: Make BGE leaf geometry inherit only genuine exterior foliage from its canonical full leaf's currently baked resource-pack model.
Use BGE canonical bindings and exact exposed SurfacePatch geometry as the sole authority for material identity, resolved topology, and decorative footprint.
scope: Install a client-only final block-model wrapper that retains BGE's existing model and projects only axis-aligned exterior canonical foliage quads over merged BGE surface patches.
Preserve copied quad sprite, tint, material/render-layer, UV, light, and normal data; exact same-canonical leaf contact suppresses only covered boundary regions.
Fail closed for missing canonical models, unsupported bindings, texture-only leaf treatments, non-grid/non-exterior quads, or incompatible leaf neighbors.

exclusions: BGE remains unchanged and owns canonical material identity plus resolved SurfacePatch topology; BGE × CTM remains optional adjacent context, not a dependency or geometry authority.
No bushy-leaf resource-pack, mod, texture, model JSON, shader, provider class, or asset is copied, redistributed, or modified. The protected Minecraft testing profiles are not inspected or changed.

Inventory, hand, creative-menu, JEI, collision, outline, placement, drops, recipes, waterlogging, leaf distance/persistence/decay, rain drip, redstone, pathfinding, and BGE family membership remain untouched.
No registry-name inference, per-geometry ID list, Stair/Wall special branch, guessed cube halo, or gameplay-state mutation is permitted.

dependencies.reason: C78 is the oldest demonstrated BGE release with authoritative resolved patches for every requested topology; C82 is the controlled compile baseline.
Canary 1 targets Minecraft Java 26.2 public block-model and final renderer-quad interfaces.
Provides public 26.2 model-loading and renderer APIs.

dependencies.requirement: optional; observed at client resource reload
dependencies.reason: The bridge consumes baked canonical leaf geometry at runtime and emits no authored foliage when a selected pack has no genuine exterior leaf geometry.
Minecraft 26.2 and the controlled build use Java 25.

state.milestone: Canary 1 is a client-only, provider-neutral canonical-model bridge. It captures the active canonical leaf baked model per resource reload, retains BGE's clean base model, and projects only actual exterior, exact-grid foliage quads over BGE's merged authoritative surfaces. The selected leaf provider remains the visual authority; a texture-only treatment needs no invented geometry and produces no added shell. No runtime client evidence is claimed.

exceptions.reason: Canary 1 uses Minecraft 26.2's public block-state model and Fabric final quad-emission seams.
regression_evidence: A clean Java 25/Fabric Loom 1.17.19 build against BGE C82 SHA-256 165229966de7e02b0a42c2b5fc90cefa116f0b626cb55a6378caea6e38f6341c produced bge-bushy-leaves-0.1.0-canary1.jar SHA-256 e85262f792638e99b5c1fdac9c48043e5bb461da55ce9a50fbc07cc1a24f7fbf from implementation checkpoint 21a98eaa5a21b6c47471781de9a353b22475b6b1.

Six focused unit tests passed: exterior-only projection, exact partial contact subtraction, fail-closed interior/wrong-face rejection, deterministic subtraction deduplication, representative compound occupancy bounds, and invalid-frame rejection.
Controlled verification passed BGE API, Fabric Renderer/model-loader hash gates, JAR metadata and required-class checks, and asset/provider exclusion checks.

current.summary: Projects genuine exterior canonical-leaf foliage over BGE's exact exposed geometry without bundling leaf-provider assets.
